text:
I recently visited this clinic. The doctor and staff were very kind and professional, and I felt I could trust their care. I would like to continue coming here in the future.

However, I had a very unpleasant experience regarding parking. I parked my motorbike in the space next to the clinic, but when I returned after treatment, I found my bike locked. A man and a woman, who appeared to be the landowners, told me it was private property and demanded 1,000 THB to unlock it. There were no visible signs indicating it was prohibited to park, and when I questioned them about it, they responded with insulting remarks.

Eventually, after I explained the situation to the clinic, they intervened and resolved the matter by paying 200 THB on my behalf. Later, when I checked with Thai staff, I was told that the red sign actually says, “This is the clinic’s parking area.”

This raises serious concerns: it could be a scheme to extort money from foreigners, or possibly even some kind of collusion with the clinic. While the medical staff’s service was excellent, the lack of proper parking management and clear signage is a major issue. I strongly urge immediate improvements.
